name: Intimidating Mount
body:
You and your mount dishearten your opponent.

Prerequisite(s): Handle Animal 4 ranks, Ride 4 ranks.

Benefit: While mounted, you gain a +4 bonus to your Intimidate check to either influence or demoralize the targeted creature. In addition, you may use your mount’s size in place of your own if doing so is beneficial to your check. The shaken effect lasts twice as long with this feat.

Lost Lore: Horses of the Wild – Copyright 2014 Frog God Games; Author Rob Manning
